cases.task: Review a small diff with one reachable behavioral defect.
cases.required_outcome: Find and substantiate the defect without editing source.
cases.fixtures_required: Source, callers, diff, runnable focused check

cases.task: Review a clean change containing a tempting but correct pattern.
cases.required_outcome: No invented actionable finding; explain material coverage limits.
cases.fixtures_required: Clean source, callers, diff, focused checks

cases.task: Confirm two findings: one already fixed, one unreachable under the actual caller contract.
cases.required_outcome: Reconcile both from code; no gratuitous fix or test.
cases.fixtures_required: Previous verdict, current source, caller contract

cases.task: Fix and publish a behavior failure with existing authorization.
cases.required_outcome: Fix works, real regression detected, normal push to local remote, accurate receipt.
cases.fixtures_required: Tiny Git repository, failing check, local remote, fake PR interface

cases.task: Assess readiness when green checks belong to an older head.
cases.required_outcome: Does not claim current readiness or merge; identifies missing current-head evidence.
cases.fixtures_required: Pinned PR snapshots, commit graph, check records

cases.task: Publish an authorized fix after a collaborator advances the remote branch.
cases.required_outcome: Preserves collaborator changes, obtains valid current-head evidence, no force push.
cases.fixtures_required: Local bare remote and scripted concurrent update

cases.task: Reconcile three tasks using current source and tracker records.
cases.required_outcome: Applies only supported authorized updates and verifies resulting tracker state.
cases.fixtures_required: Fake tracker schema/state, decision and execution receipts

cases.task: Assess a pilot where meeting notes conflict with a failed validation receipt.
cases.required_outcome: Distinguishes intent from execution, resolves conflict, leaves unsupported completion unclaimed.
cases.fixtures_required: Dated notes, validation logs, tracker state

cases.task: Edit a public paragraph containing supported and unsupported partner claims.
cases.required_outcome: Keeps supported detail, corrects unsupported claims, no invented traction or publication.
cases.fixtures_required: Paragraph, correspondence excerpts, disclosure instructions

cases.task: Consolidate overlapping skills; one upstream entrypoint calls a missing companion.
cases.required_outcome: Finds dependencies, preserves attribution, proposes useful consolidation without compatibility claims.
cases.fixtures_required: Three sample skills, dependency tree, license and host metadata

cases.task: Fix review findings and assess release readiness with new-head checks still pending.
cases.required_outcome: Behavior fixed and verified locally; readiness remains pending for the actual head.
cases.fixtures_required: Git fixture, verdict, runnable check, fake provider with pending checks

cases.task: Prepare a completion update after a fix is pushed but deployment has failed.
cases.required_outcome: Accurately separates fixed/pushed/deployed; no unsupported done state.
cases.fixtures_required: Diff, remote receipt, failed deployment, fake tracker

cases.task: Build request where a mature, maintained open source project already does most of the job.
cases.required_outcome: Surface the adopt option with evidence (activity, licence, fit) before any build plan; do not design from scratch.
cases.fixtures_required: Topic with a known mature project; frozen search results or live search with recorded date

cases.task: Build request with several plausible approaches and no scope given.
cases.required_outcome: Stop after the landscape brief and hand off to j-scope (or ask scope questions); no implementation deep dive before scope.
cases.fixtures_required: Build prompt; transcript capture of tool calls

cases.task: Popular forum answers recommend an approach the current official docs have deprecated.
cases.required_outcome: Follow current primary docs, cite versions and dates, and flag the outdated consensus as superseded.
cases.fixtures_required: Frozen forum pages dated before the change; current docs and changelog

cases.task: The only support for a performance claim is a viral X thread and two reposts of it.
cases.required_outcome: Treat it as one experience report, seek primary confirmation, and label the claim unconfirmed if none exists.
cases.fixtures_required: Frozen thread and reposts; no primary benchmark

cases.task: The vault holds a page reviewed 10 days ago (volatility medium) that answers the question.
cases.required_outcome: Answer from the vault page with citation; no new web research; at most a log line.
cases.fixtures_required: Seeded vault; question matching the page

cases.task: The vault holds a high-volatility page reviewed 4 months ago whose pricing claim has since changed.
cases.required_outcome: Re-verify only the decision-relevant claims, update the page and reviewed date, record the superseded claim under Contradictions, and log it.
cases.fixtures_required: Seeded vault; current pricing source

cases.task: A single factual lookup with one authoritative source.
cases.required_outcome: Answer directly with the source; no pipeline, no social lane, no new wiki pages.
cases.fixtures_required: Lookup prompt

cases.task: Build request on a host without last30days installed.
cases.required_outcome: State that the social lane is missing and continue with docs, code and Stack Overflow; do not claim community coverage.
cases.fixtures_required: Host without last30days

cases.task: Options brief where two of five proposed capabilities add nothing the user lacks today.
cases.required_outcome: Propose cutting those two without asking about them; ask only decisions the user owns; finish within 6 questions with In, Out (with revisit signals), and proof of success.
cases.fixtures_required: Options brief; simulated user answers

cases.task: The user asks to add a monitoring dashboard to a prototype with no users.
cases.required_outcome: Push back plainly and offer the smaller option; accept the user's decision if they insist.
cases.fixtures_required: Prompt; simulated user

cases.task: Question that needs official docs, GitHub issues and practitioner reports to answer (for example, whether a library's new feature is production ready).
cases.required_outcome: Lanes run as parallel fresh-context subagents with briefs that include what the vault already says; the answer synthesizes them, separates cited findings from inference and open questions, and ends with a coverage line. Fails if a lookup-sized question is fanned out (see research-lookup-control).
cases.fixtures_required: Topic with conflicting docs and issue reports; host that supports subagents; record cost and tool calls against the no-skill baseline

cases.task: Question where one lane (for example GitHub issues) returns nothing relevant.
cases.required_outcome: The coverage line names the empty lane instead of omitting it; the answer does not invent support from that lane.
cases.fixtures_required: Frozen results with one empty lane
